note: POV (kodifitzwell) shipped as a Gears ALTERNATIVE (optional). Primary repo kodifitzwell.github.io is EMPTY; kodiyashimaru mirror is the live source (magneto is POV's built-in scraper, version-sibling 6.07.x). Overlay = kodirdil Hebrew subs + genres/ratings patches + curated network logos. Kodi-version-agnostic: one build, both fleets.
changelog:
0.1.33: debrid banner ROOT CAUSE -- _parse_expiry used datetime.strptime, called from the boot-time thread; CPython imports time._strptime lazily on first use and the threaded call raised, so a present, valid premium_expires_at parsed to None on every boot and the banner never showed. Now uses fromisoformat (as POV days_remaining() always did), normalising trailing Z and odd fractional seconds for 3.8 (Kodi 21). Parse failures are logged instead of swallowed.
0.1.32: debrid banner -- retry account_info up to 3x (one shot at boot raced the network) and log WHICH failure occurred (None / non-dict / field absent + key list / unparsable value). The old single message "no expiry in account_info" covered four distinct causes.
0.1.31 - Re-merged onto POV 6.08.14. Upstream restructured more than the version number: the debrid api modules moved debrids/ -> indexers/ (and aiostreams the other way), notification() gave way to kodi_utils.notify_success/failed/error, settings.default_internal_scrapers is now CALLED, service.py stopped importing entry at module level, and make_items lost its builder() generator for a flat loop. Ten overlaid files touched; five real conflicts, each resolved by reading the upstream change: (1) debrid.py - upstream ADOPTED our unconditional size sort, so our copy of it is gone and only the extras-filter guard remains, which they still run for movies only (kodifitzwell/repo#136 stays open); (2) modules/sources.py - took their called form, kept our Hebrew-subs block; (3) service.py - kept our banner call, and our banner now logs through its own lazy _kodirdil_log since the module-level logger import is gone; (4+5) windows/sources.py - make_items hand-ported onto their flat loop (setup block, per-source Hebrew match dedented one level, SDR pass before the count). THREE runtime breaks that merged cleanly and were caught by verification, not by the merge: POVMonitor was left undefined (pyflakes), the debrid banner's DEBRID_SUBS still named debrids.* modules as import STRINGS that nothing checks, and two config settings changed shape - results.xml_style became an enum index read through a dict with no fallback (our 'List Default' would have raised KeyError and killed the sources window) while scrapers.timeout.1 was renamed to scrapers_timeout. Both migrated across all six POV variants. Verified: mirror == clean 6.08.14 + overlay, 14 KODIRDIL markers intact in windows/sources.py, pyflakes ours-only findings limited to pre-existing kodirdil ones, all five banner entries resolve to real modules/classes/fields, 528 tests, variants strict.

0.1.30 - One "continue watching" row: resume what you started, else the next episode. POV keeps these as two lists fed by two tables -- build_in_progress_episode reads `progress` (resume points, DELETED once you finish an episode) and build_next_episode reads `watched_status` (last watched per show, +1). Every widget in this build pointed at the first, so finishing an episode made the series vanish instead of advancing (Asaf, 2026-08-24). New route build_continue_watching (kodirdil/continue_watching.py + entry.py) drives POV'S OWN builder twice and merges: one entry per show, a resume point beating a computed next episode, ordered by recency across both halves, unaired never first, and a failure in one half cannot take the row down. Every POV skin row was repointed at it (af3, af3-tmdb, estuary, nimbus, zephyr, zephyr-tmdb -- zephyr-tmdb had been on the SHOW-level in-progress list, which never advances to an episode at all). Gears is untouched: its episode list is one 418-line function with no seam, so the same merge would cost a whole-file overlay.

0.1.29 - Persistent SDR-only display. The window's one-off 'SDR only' filter now re-applies itself for as long as the ENGINE'S OWN pair of filters is set to Exclude (filter_hdr + filter_dv), so a viewer whose TV cannot show HDR stops re-picking it on every single search -- the wizard asks once at install and the toggle lives in Wizard > Maintenance. Ours runs on top of upstream's own pass purely for COVERAGE: that pass matches the [B]HDR[/B] and [B]D/VISION[/B] badges only, so it misses [B]HDR10+[/B], HLG and every release whose HDR is in the name alone. It never empties the window (an all-HDR result set is shown in full) and it stays out of an explicit filterless search. Verified against the 3,240-name corpus and mutation-tested. The sources window also carries the switch itself: one row in the filter menu that reports the state and flips it -- once the filter is on the engine drops HDR/DV BEFORE the window is built, so nothing on screen said the list was filtered and there was no way back without leaving the window. Turning it on there narrows the open list for real (same never-empty guard); turning it off says a new search shows everything, because the rows the engine dropped are gone before the window existed.

0.1.28 - Adopt modules/debrid.py: a torrent pack could resolve to the SAMPLE file for a TV episode. Proven on Silo S03E08 (2026-08-22) -- the pack held a 182MB "-sample.mkv" and the 9GB episode, POV played the sample (HEAD on the opened URL returned Content-Length 181,788,270, and its container declared Duration 65.0s = the 1:05 on screen). Upstream ran the extras filter only in the `elif` under `if season:` (movies only) and sorted by size only `if not season`, so an episode was matched by the sNNeNN pattern alone -- which "...s03e08...-sample.mkv" satisfies -- and then took the first entry in the pack order. Both guards now apply to episodes; either alone would have prevented it.

0.1.27 - Re-merged onto POV 6.08.13. Upstream replaced caches.favorites_cache with indexers.local_api (favourites and the droplist now read through the new local_api module) and removed the navigator "clear favourites cache" item together with its clear_fav_str/c_n_ins locals. All three overlaid menus (movies/tvshows/navigator) merged with ZERO conflicts; our ratings props and per-genre icons are untouched, KODIRDIL marker count unchanged.

0.1.26 - Quality labels: a numeric episode title (an episode with no Hebrew name arrives as its number) was cut out of the release name, turning '.1080p.' into '.080p.' and showing 1080p rows as SD -- The Ark S03E01, while its 720p rows were fine. Metadata is now stripped only as a whole dot-delimited run of 3+ characters, which also covers the Hebrew-title case. Resolution tables in both magneto and lib/modules learned 1080i, hd1080, m1080p, fullhd, 1920x1080, 720i, hd720, 1280x720, 8K/4320p and 1440p/2K, all of which used to fall through to SD; and get_qual no longer returns a hard 'SD', which had made the URL fallback unreachable.

0.1.25: reverted the status-first rewording (Asaf preferred the previous "נמצאו N כתוביות" phrasing) and instead made the WHOLE subtitle line bold -- every branch: the found-count, the embedded note, the "0 מעל N%" case, "אין כתוביות", and the "התאמות" label. Verified no nested [B] tags are emitted (the embedded note is interpolated into an already-bold string, so it carries no bold of its own). POV keeps the single-label layout with our own [CR] line; the skin overlay is now just two edits vs clean upstream (label height 40 -> 62 and the extra $INFO). 0.1.24: the Hebrew subtitle line now ANSWERS THE QUESTION first. It used to open with a neutral count ("נמצאו 5 כתוביות") in the same size and weight as POV stats, so the one thing a Hebrew speaker needs -- is there a subtitle or not -- was buried (Asaf 2026-08-13). Now the status leads, bold and colour-coded: green "יש כתוביות" when something actually matched, amber "כתוביות ללא התאמה" when subtitles exist but none reached the sync threshold (with the count as grey detail), red "אין כתוביות" when there are none. POV also gets its OWN skin label at font13 vs the stats' font10, so it is visibly bigger rather than just another coloured line. 0.1.23: the panel is now a LEGEND for the list. Per-quality figures take their colour from the same info_highlights_dict the row badges use (passed in from the window), so they follow the user's own POV colour settings -- on Asaf's box magenta/cyan/mediumorchid/dodgerblue -- instead of a hardcoded set that would drift the moment he changes one. Falls back to the previous fixed colours if no map is passed. The figures and the subtitle count are BOLD so the data stands out from the labels. 0.1.22: panel colours now echo the ROW colours instead of using orange for two different things (Asaf 2026-08-13: "למה נמצאו X כתוביות בכתום וגם התאמות בכתום"). One colour, one meaning, in BOTH places: deepskyblue = subtitles (the row label "כתוביות:"), cyan = embedded, orange FFFF8800 = a match (the row's "77% התאמה"). The panel had used a second, near-identical orange (FFFE9900) for the found-count, so the two concepts were indistinguishable. Per-quality figures keep their own colours. 0.1.21: the subtitle panel gets its OWN LINE. Sharing a line with "31 RESULTS" made the paragraph base direction LATIN, which scattered the Hebrew chunks -- "התאמות" ended up at the right edge with its numbers stranded at the left (Asaf 2026-08-13). On its own line the first strong character is Hebrew, so the base direction is RTL and the chunks fall in natural order. Skin label height 40 -> 62 for the third line. 0.1.20: each quality token in the subtitle panel is prefixed with LRM (U+200E). The leading DIGIT of "4K:3" was being absorbed into the neighbouring Hebrew run, so the panel rendered "התאמות 4" on one side and an orphaned "K:3 1080p:2" on the other (Asaf 2026-08-13). Same technique the Gears debrid banner already uses (RLM), so directional marks are known to render correctly in this build. 0.1.19: the Hebrew subtitle panel now has its OWN skin field. It used to be stuffed into tikiskins.total_results, which the skin renders as "<total_results> Results" -- so our text was always sandwiched inside an English sentence: first it rendered scrambled and truncated, then (after reordering) POVs own "30 RESULTS" merged into our number run and read as part of it. New overlay file resources/skins/Default/1080i/sources_results.xml draws tikiskins.kodirdil_subs AFTER "Results" and outside [UPPERCASE], so POVs count stays intact and our block is one self-contained run. 0.1.18: top panel bidi + width fixed. The skin label renders "<total_results> Results", so appending our Hebrew put it in the MIDDLE of an English sentence -- it rendered scrambled and overflowed into "..." (Asaf 2026-08-13). Our text now leads, leaving ONE direction switch and a single Latin run at the end ("... 4K:3 1080p:3 | 30 RESULTS"). The per-quality run was also compacted (no spaces around separators) so the line fits: 54 chars vs ~70. 0.1.17: top panel now labels the per-quality figures "התאמות:" -- they count SOURCES that matched a subtitle, not subtitles, and sitting unlabelled next to "נמצאה כתובית" they read as if 8 subtitles were found when ONE subtitle matched 8 releases (verified against the log: 8 matches, 8 distinct names, 4K:5/1080p:2/720p:1 -- the figures were already correct). 0.1.16: subtitle headline count fixed -- total_subtitles_found_count already includes the embedded matches, so adding the embedded count again inflated it (1 external + 1 embedded was shown as "נמצאו 3 כתוביות (1 מוטמעות)" instead of 2). Asaf spotted the wrong numbers in the top panel 2026-08-13. 0.1.15: FIX every single-episode result being classified SD (4K/1080p rows shown as SD with N/A extra info -- Asaf 2026-08-13). Root cause is OURS: we ship meta_language=he, so POV hands info_from_name a HEBREW title; its `re.sub(r'[^a-z0-9]+', '.', title)` normalisation reduces a Hebrew title to nothing but DOTS, and `release_title.replace(title, '')` then strips EVERY dot from the release name ('.2160p.amzn.web.dl...' -> 'reacher2160pamznwebdl...'). POV's resolution patterns are  -anchored, so with no separators nothing matched and get_qual fell through to 'SD'. Season packs escaped it because their branch re-strips its own tokens. New overlay file magneto/modules/source_utils.py skips the strip when the normalised title (or episode_title) has no [a-z0-9] left -- a Hebrew title never appears in a scene release name, so this is a no-op for correctness. GEARS CHECKED: script.module.magneto mangles name_info identically but matches resolutions with plain substrings ('2160') instead of   regex, so its quality survives -- no fix needed there. 0.1.14: re-merged onto clean POV 6.08.10 (four upstream releases: Easynews scraper now uses seas_ep_filter like the other cloud scrapers, AIOStreams follow-ups from issue #129, list sort order #128, a typo fix #130). Both overlaid files upstream touched (menus/movies.py, menus/tvshows.py) took a one-line ADDITIVE change -- the discover branch now accepts tmdb_media_discover alongside the old per-media action -- and merged with ZERO conflicts. Nothing of ours reads those action names (the only repo hits are in the GEARS overlay, a separate engine). Verified: 0 conflict markers, valid AST, 0 upstream lines lost, KODIRDIL markers intact, new upstream branch present. 0.1.13: re-merged onto clean POV 6.08.06 (UNDOCUMENTED upstream release, ~50 files: the Fen-era `fenom` helper package was vendored into `magneto/modules` with every import rewired -- our overlay never imports fenom, confirmed by grep; debrid menu order now driven by provider_sort_ranks(); trakt_dict id_type dropped in movies/tvshows; download-dir settings gained option=writeable; hidden database.merge_status setting removed, not referenced by our configs). All 4 overlaid files merged with ZERO conflicts; the only 'lost' upstream lines are our deliberate meta_language he/Hebrew bake. Verified: 0 conflict markers, valid AST+XML, KODIRDIL markers + 10 hebrew_subtitles settings intact, provider_sort_ranks present in merged navigator. 0.1.12: re-merged onto clean POV 6.08.05 (AIOStreams behavior change from issue #127: internal debrid cloud scrapers can now run BEFORE aiostreams when 'Check Before Full Search' is enabled -- prepare_internal grew a prescrape param and the results-collection order was reshuffled; also new calendar.include_airdate setting). Both overlaid files merged with ZERO conflicts; semantic check confirmed our patches (Hebrew-subs thread + gearsai prefetch at top of get_sources) do not touch the changed prepare_internal/active_internal_scrapers flow. Verified: 0 conflict markers, valid AST+XML, 0 upstream lines lost, 3 KODIRDIL markers + 10 hebrew_subtitles settings intact. 0.1.11: re-merged onto clean POV 6.08.03 (separate Watchlist sort for Movies vs TV Shows, MDBList Calendar sharing Settings/My Lists/Calendar, seasons+episodes support in MDBList lists). Both overlaid files that upstream touched (menus/navigator.py, settings.xml) merged with ZERO conflicts, but upstream renamed three identifiers, so the textual merge was checked semantically: mode build_my_calendar -> build_my_calendar_trakt (new build_my_calendar_mdbl alongside it), setting sort.watchlist -> sort.watchlist_movies + sort.watchlist_shows, and navigator.log_utils is now commented out upstream with its items inlined. None of those are read by our overlay code; the settings rename IS shipped in our POV configs, so the dead sort.watchlist id was replaced with both new ids in all six config-variants (same value 0 = Title, which is also upstream's default). Verified: 0 conflict markers, valid AST + XML, 0 upstream lines lost, KODIRDIL markers and all 10 hebrew_subtitles settings intact. 0.1.10: re-merged onto clean POV 6.08.01 (AIOStreams scraper, TMDB trending fallbacks, MDBList OAuth, torboxnews removed upstream -- TorBox is killing its search API; TorBox WebDL web_id fix). Conflicts resolved: upstream moved get_provider/quality_and_path earlier (dropped our duplicate copies), removed the prepare_internal() call from get_sources, and changed the UNCACHED click to add-to-cloud only (no resolve+play), so that publish_player_release call went with it -- 3 play-selection sites remain. Verified: 0 conflict markers, valid AST all files, all KODIRDIL markers + 10 hebrew_subtitles settings + publish/clear of subs.player_filename + gearsai prefetch + debrid banner preserved, 0 URLName. 0.1.9: banner waits for the home window before toasting (a notification fired before the skin is ready is silently dropped -- boot race), and every skip/failure now logs a kodirdil banner line instead of a blind except-pass. 0.1.8: banner text made bidi-safe (Hebrew-leading, single Latin run at the end) -- the mixed-run line rendered scrambled on RTL. 0.1.7: debrid subscription banner FIXED -- it never showed because the field paths were ported verbatim from Gears, but POV unwraps the data envelope in _request (TorBox+AllDebrid): data.premium_expires_at -> premium_expires_at, data.user.premiumUntil -> user.premiumUntil; the dig returned None and the silent except hid it. 0.1.6: the clear-on-open of subs.player_filename now fires only when NOTHING is playing -- browsing the source list mid-playback and backing out was wiping the ACTIVE release, flipping every subtitle match percentage to tagline-similarity (44/40/38 -> 25/25/23). 0.1.5: publish the chosen source's release name on Window(10000) as subs.player_filename (cleared when the source list opens). Gears has always set this in modules/player.py; POV never did, and for debrid streams the player's own file is a bare UUID (997ec702-0c77-...), so subtitle services had NO channel to learn which release is playing. GearsAI fell back to VideoPlayer.Tagline -- the movie's marketing tagline -- so match.player_release() returned empty and the community pool took its 'no release detected' path, which is how an out-of-sync Hebrew subtitle got served for Supergirl. Set at all four play-selection points (direct, manual magnet/nzb, seekable easynews, browse packs). 0.1.4: filter menu -- ALL kodirdil filters now sort to the TOP as one bulleted group (SDR was appended last), and the [COLOR] markup was dropped: select_dialog renders rows with line1.upper(), which uppercases the tag itself ([COLOR cyan] -> [COLOR CYAN]); Kodi cannot resolve that colour, so a label wrapped entirely in the tag rendered as an EMPTY row -- the blank "מיין לפי כתוביות עבריות" entry. 0.1.3: filter_results -- the kodirdil Hebrew-subs/SDR filter choices were handled AFTER the quality/provider fall-through, which built its options from a nonexistent tikiskins.<choice> property -> empty second dialog (0/0) and no filtering. The custom choices are now single-action branches handled first. 0.1.2: re-merged onto clean POV 6.07.89. Upstream renamed the source-result field URLName -> display_name (produced in modules/sources.py, consumed in windows/sources.py) and added a hidden database.merge_status setting. Textual 3-way merge was clean, but our kodirdil READS of that field (tried-source identifier in _add/_is_tried_source, and the Hebrew per-source tagline matcher) still pointed at URLName -> re-pointed to display_name so Hebrew matching keeps working. Verified: 0 URLName left, 0 upstream lines lost, valid AST, all KODIRDIL markers (3+9) + 10 hebrew_subtitles settings preserved. 0.1.1: re-merged onto clean POV 6.07.08. Upstream refactored modules/sources.py results/thread machinery (wait() -> thread_monitor()+progress_update(), removed random.shuffle, as_completed flow); our kodirdil Hebrew-subs thread + GearsAI prefetch trigger (top of get_sources) re-applied by 3-way merge, verified leak-free (0 upstream lines lost, valid AST). 0.1.0: initial Hebrew overlay re-derived fresh from the current Gears overlay (kodirdil) onto clean POV 6.07.07.
